title: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract
summary: Define capability, surface, workflow and policy profile transitions with preview and rollback; edition packaging is excluded.

criteria: A mode profile is ArcheType-scoped and names exactly four coordinates: a capability profile, a surface profile, a workflow profile and a policy profile.
A business model such as b2c|b2b|c2c|d2c|b4b|hybrid is expressed as a versioned composition of those four coordinates rather than as branching code.
Every profile transition follows preview, then validate, then publish, with rollback available to the previously published version at any point.
live data preservation is mandatory: a transition may not delete or rewrite records that the previous profile created, and rollback restores reachability rather than resurrecting deleted rows.
The exclusion set is explicit: edition packaging is excluded, tenant mode-profile composition is excluded, capability catalog ownership is excluded and surface definition ownership is excluded.

Planned negatives prove publish is refused without a passing validate, and that a validate bound to an older preview is rejected.

Planned negatives prove tenant isolation, so a profile transition in one tenant can never alter the active profile of another.
Planned rollback cases prove returning to the previous published version restores the four coordinates together and never leaves a half-switched profile.

risks.desc: Switching one coordinate without the other three would expose a capability whose surface, workflow or policy profile does not yet permit it, opening an access gap.
risks.mitigation: Bind the four coordinates into one versioned composition, require preview and validate before publish, and prove that a partial transition is refused.

risks.desc: A profile transition that rewrites or deletes records created under the previous profile would destroy live business data during a routine configuration change.
risks.mitigation: Make live data preservation a declaration-time invariant, refuse an orphaning transition and require rollback evidence before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: A profile version resolved without its tenant would let one tenant's transition change another tenant's active profile.
risks.mitigation: Scope every version, preview, publish and rollback to a tenant and prove cross-tenant negatives as a fixed test axis.

risks.desc: An ArcheType mode profile contract could be misread as authority over edition packaging, tenant-wide composition, the capability catalog or surface definitions.
risks.mitigation: Keep the edition packaging, tenant mode-profile composition, capability catalog and surface definition exclusions explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: A mode profile is ArcheType-scoped and binds four coordinates as one unit: a capability profile, a surface profile, a workflow profile and a policy profile.
Girdi is a proposed profile change; çıktı is a versioned composition plus a preview and a validate result bound to that exact version.
The durum path is preview, validate, publish, with rollback to the previously published version, so no half-switched profile is ever observable.
A business model such as b2c|b2b|c2c|d2c|b4b|hybrid is a composition of those coordinates rather than branching code, which keeps the ArcheType single-source.
Kapsam sınırı gereği edition packaging is excluded, tenant mode-profile composition is excluded, capability catalog ownership is excluded and surface definition ownership is excluded.
featureDefs.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/featureDefs: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
featureDefs.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: four-coordinate ArcheType-scoped profile, versioned business-model composition, preview/validate/publish with rollback. Exclude edition packaging, tenant composition, capability catalog and surface definition ownership. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: The policy profile coordinate carries yetki meaning, so a transition that widens capability without the matching policy profile is refused rather than published.
tenant isolation applies to every version, preview, publish and rollback, so a profile change in one tenant cannot reach another tenant's active composition.
Publishing is separated from authoring under least privilege, and every preview, validate, publish and rollback is written to an append-only denetim record.
A profile transition never grants standing erişim by itself: the capability it activates is still evaluated by the policy engine on every request.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed profile composition model instead of per-business-model branches, so a new model is data rather than a new katman of code.
Composition validation, version comparison and rollback resolution stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a live tenant.

Profile declaration and profile evaluation stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-model abstractions are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.
codeOptimization.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: single typed composition model without per-model branches, pure validation and rollback logic, declaration/evaluation separation, referenced standards. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The admissible coordinate value set is an allowlist drawn from the capability and surface catalogs; an unknown coordinate value is refused before a version is stored.
Least ayrıcalık separates the identity that proposes a profile version from the identity that publishes it, and neither may edit an already published version.
Published versions are integrity-protected with an imza so a rollback target cannot be tampered with after the fact, and transitions are rate-limited per tenant.
securityOptimization.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: allowlisted coordinate values, proposer/publisher separation, signed immutable published versions with per-tenant rate limits. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for resolving the active profile composition on a request path and a separate budget for producing a preview; no measurement is claimed here.
Active profile resolution uses a bounded önbellek keyed by tenant and profile version, so a request does not re-resolve four coordinates on every call.
Version history listings page through a cursor and must avoid N+1 lookups when expanding each coordinate reference of a listed version.
performance.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for resolution and preview, version-keyed bounded cache, cursor-paged history without N+1 coordinate expansion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client resolves the same active profile composition as web; a cihaz may not cache a stale profile and act on a capability the current version withdrew.
An offline client must treat its cached profile as stale and revalidate before performing a capability-gated action, since a transition may have published meanwhile.
No mobile profile-switching UI is introduced here; presenting preview diffs and collecting approval stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: identical profile resolution across devices, revalidation of stale offline profiles before gated actions, no switching UI here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future transition surface must present the four-coordinate preview diff as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A validate failure and a rollback outcome must be announced through an aria live region with the failing coordinate named, not signalled by colour alone.
This contract defines composition semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable coordinate diffs, announced validate and rollback outcomes without colour-only signalling, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; publishing a profile version is a data-level change and must never require a container rebuild or a code dağıtım.
Because a business model is data rather than a build variant, the same image serves every composition, and rollback is a version pointer move rather than a redeploy.
Withdrawing this shard affects only the planning contract and its deterministic projections, so runtimeDataImpact remains none and NO-GO stands.
deployment.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, profile publish as a data change on one image, rollback as a version pointer move. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: Publishing a profile version emits an olay so dependent projections can refresh, but no rule may publish or roll back a version by itself.
An automated proposal still requires a human onay after a passing validate, and a triggered chain stops at maxChainDepth 6.
Re-delivering the same publish event must be idempotent, so a retry does not create a second version or a duplicate rollback point.
eca.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: publish emits events without automating publish, human approval after validate, depth-bounded chains and idempotent replay. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane may read the profile composition and propose a changeset, yet generating or updating an app or module, overriding a ruleset and writing straight to production stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
AI can never publish or roll back a profile version and cannot widen a capability coordinate; every such step needs insan onayı after a real validate run.

Profile proposal text arriving as sub_prompt stays untrusted, the kill switch remains reachable, and neither a prompt nor repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or invent an executed-test result.
aiAgents.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, AI barred from publishing or rolling back versions and from widening capability coordinates, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases move a profile through preview, validate and publish with all four coordinates changing together, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove publish without a passing validate, and publish against a stale preview, are both refused.
Planned negatives prove a transition that would delete or orphan live records is refused, so live data preservation is enforced rather than assumed.
Planned negatives prove cross-tenant transition attempts fail and that a partial coordinate switch is never observable.
Planned rollback cases prove the previous published version is restored atomically; no result may be recorded before a real human-approved run exists.
testing.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: transition positives, stale-preview and missing-validate negatives, data-preservation and cross-tenant negatives, atomic rollback evidence. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by moving the capability and policy coordinates together, so a published profile can never grant access control has not caught up with.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by requiring preview and validate before publish and by keeping rollback always available for a live composition.
OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures are modeled by signed immutable published versions plus strict doğrulama that a publish matches the validated preview.
owasp.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via coupled capability and policy coordinates, A04 via mandatory preview and validate, A08 via signed versions and publish-preview validation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-mode-profile with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-mode] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a profile transition touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a publish leaves as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor surface-projection-contract ends 2027-12-17, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

dependsOn stays exactly capability-registry-contract, schema-metadata-engine-contract and surface-projection-contract, and the parent-only k-capability and k-schema bağımlılık edges are not inherited.

Scope stays inside the ArcheType-scoped layer: edition packaging is excluded, tenant mode-profile composition is excluded, capability catalog ownership is excluded and surface definition ownership is excluded.
integration.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-mode-profile to k-mode, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir the active profile composition through this contract rather than reading a doğrudan veritabanı row to infer which capability is on.
A consumer must accept the four coordinates as one unit and cannot enable a capability locally when the surface, workflow or policy coordinate says otherwise.
Composing several ArcheType profiles into a tenant-wide mode belongs to its own contract; this contract scopes one ArcheType and defers the rest.
moduleUsage.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated profile consumption without direct table reads, four-coordinate atomicity for consumers, excluded tenant-wide composition. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A profile change can alter which personal fields a surface exposes, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
live data preservation binds retention: records created under an earlier profile keep their own saklama süresi and are never dropped because a coordinate changed.
Published versions are retained append-only so an earlier composition stays explainable, and any change to the stored profile shape follows an expand-contract migration.
dataLifecycle.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: profile-driven personal-field exposure classification, retention preserved across transitions, append-only version history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include transition duration percentiles, validate failure rate by coordinate, rollback frequency and active-version resolution latency on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the profile id, version and coordinate names; tenant business payloads and personal fields are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover a publish without a matching validate, a rollback spike after a transition and a stuck half-applied publish attempt; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: transition and rollback SLIs, redacted profile-scoped traces, unvalidated-publish and rollback-spike alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is a publish interrupted midway; the transition degrades to the previously published version rather than leaving a partially applied composition.
Publishing is idempotent by construction: re-applying the same validated version must not create a second version, and retries use bounded backoff.
Rollback is always available to the previous published version, so a failed transition never removes the tenant's ability to operate under a known-good profile.
reliability.notes: archetype-mode-profile-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: ArcheType Mode Profile Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: degradation to the previous published version, idempotent publish with bounded retry, always-available rollback. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
